headline: The footer says 654-0789. A few shop pages still say call 334-9771.
summary: This is a real family fence shop at 10039 Prospect Avenue, Suite K, in Santee, licensed 946946, on the lot since 2003. Sam already shows up in the reviews. Yelp is claimed, about 41 notes, updated this month. The Contact block this week prints (619) 654-0789 and sam@samsfence.net. Shop-owned hours are Monday through Friday 7 to 3:30, Saturday and Sunday closed. Yelp matches that. BuildZoom still prints (619) 334-9771. So do the Fences, Gates, and Doors pages on the shop. A neighbor who trusts the leftover number can call a door that is not the mobile Sam answers.
